# Kaspa-x402 alpha.9 conformance vectors

These files are unmodified vectors from Kaspa-x402 release
`v0.1.0-alpha.9`, source commit
`49977139b8200336968f38e83a8e6700a1e3a36c`.

Sompi verifies their exact byte lengths and SHA-256 digests in the packaged
conformance suite. They cover the exact HTTP exchange, standard-native and
additive consensus profiles, canonical exact authorization expiry, and
canonical batch requirements/commitment digests.

The upstream licence is included as `LICENSE`.
